dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員ですよろしくおねがいします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 本日はどういったご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What kind of concern brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 借金を返せず困ってます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling because I can't repay my debts.

dialogue.content: それは大変困りますよね。。
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 自業自得ですが、変わらないです
dialogue.English: It's my own fault, but I can't change.

dialogue.content: いつ頃から借金返済に悩まれているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been struggling with debt repayment?

dialogue.content: 4年前です
dialogue.English: For four years.

dialogue.content: 返しては借りの繰り返しです
dialogue.English: It's a cycle of paying back and borrowing again.

dialogue.content: そんなに長い期間借金に苦しめられながら、頑張ってこられたのですね。。
dialogue.English: You've been struggling with this debt for such a long time... you've done well to keep going.

dialogue.content: 頑張っているというよりももう、当たり前になってしまったます
dialogue.English: It's less about trying hard and more that it's just become normal for me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、しんど過ぎてもう何も感じれない状況ということでしょうか、、
dialogue.English: I see. Does that mean the situation has become so exhausting that you've become numb to it?

dialogue.content: いや、借金する事に抵抗がなくなってしまってます。
dialogue.English: No, it's more that I've lost my resistance to borrowing money.

dialogue.content: ですが、このままではいけないのはわかっておりますが、変われないです
dialogue.English: But I know I can't go on like this, I just can't seem to change.

dialogue.content: 抵抗がない…でも何とかこの状況から抜けたしたいですよね。。
dialogue.English: No resistance... but you still want to find a way out of this situation, don't you?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。。
dialogue.English: That's right...

dialogue.content: もう少し状況お聴きしてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I ask a bit more about your situation?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 借入先はどういったお相手（会社？）になるのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Who are you borrowing from? Are they companies?

dialogue.content: 消費者金融です三社から借りてます
dialogue.English: They are consumer finance companies. I'm borrowing from three of them.

dialogue.content: 今は合計120万です
dialogue.English: Right now, the total is 1.2 million yen.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それは本当に苦しい状況ですよね。。
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds like a truly difficult situation.

dialogue.content: そもそも借金をするようになったきっかけは何かあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What initially led you to start borrowing money?

dialogue.content: ギャンブルと風俗から抜け出せないです
dialogue.English: I can't break free from gambling and using sex services.

dialogue.content: 自分でも止めたいと思っているのに、抜け出せないのは本当に辛いですよね。。
dialogue.English: It must be so painful to want to stop but feel like you can't escape.

dialogue.content: そうなんです、それでしか欲求が満たせないです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's the only way I can satisfy my urges.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mhm.

dialogue.content: 新し事を始めても刺激が足りなくて、結局戻ってしまいます
dialogue.English: Even when I start something new, it's not stimulating enough, and I end up going back.

dialogue.content: もう、依存だとおもいます
dialogue.English: I think it's an addiction now.

dialogue.content: 完全に
dialogue.English: Completely.

dialogue.content: そろそろお金も借りれなくなりそうで、焦りもあり、自殺もよぎったりします
dialogue.English: It seems like I'll soon be unable to borrow any more money, and I'm starting to panic. Sometimes thoughts of suicide even cross my mind.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。もう自分でもどうしていいか分からない状況で、自殺を考えるくらい追いつめられているのですね。。
dialogue.English: I see... You're in a situation where you don't know what to do anymore, and you feel so cornered that you're even considering suicide.

dialogue.content: でもまだ、働く気力はあるのですが、どうしても、ギャンブル、風俗、暴飲暴食して、返済もあまり出来ない感じです
dialogue.English: But I still have the will to work. It's just that I can't help but gamble, use sex services, and binge eat and drink, so I can't make much progress on my repayments.

dialogue.content: 稼いだお金はすぐなくなります
dialogue.English: The money I earn disappears right away.

dialogue.content: 情けないです
dialogue.English: I feel pathetic.

dialogue.content: それは毎日毎日が自転車操業のような状態で、蟻地獄のように苦しさから抜け出せないですよね。。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're living hand-to-mouth every single day, trapped in a cycle of hardship you can't escape, like being in quicksand.

dialogue.content: まさにそんな感じです
dialogue.English: That's exactly how it feels.

dialogue.content: 前向きな友人にいつも励まされてやりたい事を見つければ変わると言われますが
dialogue.English: I have a positive friend who always encourages me and says I'll change if I find something I want to do, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その時は一瞬やるきになるのですが、
dialogue.English: In that moment I feel motivated for a bit, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 1人になり暇になると、体が勝手にパチンコ屋にむかってます
dialogue.English: ...but when I'm alone and have free time, my body just automatically heads to the pachinko parlor.

dialogue.content: やばいですよね。。
dialogue.English: That's really bad, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですよね、寂しい気持ちを抱えたまま励まされても。。そっちに逃げてしまうのも無理はないと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I understand. Receiving encouragement while still feeling lonely... it's understandable that you would turn to that as an escape.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: 自分が弱いだけだとおもってます
dialogue.English: I think I'm just weak.

dialogue.content: 強くなりたいです
dialogue.English: I want to become stronger.

dialogue.content: 決してご自身が弱いのではないと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think you're weak at all.

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね
dialogue.English: Really?

dialogue.content: いま、ギャンブルとかに逃げてしまうその寂しさがどこから来るのか？そこを一緒に考えていきたいと思いますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to explore with you where this loneliness that makes you escape into gambling is coming from. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ギャンブルなどにはまるようになったのはいつ頃からでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When did you first get into things like gambling?

dialogue.content: 20年まえです
dialogue.English: Twenty years ago.

dialogue.content: 10年まえには一回返済できたのですが、また繰り返してます
dialogue.English: I managed to pay it all off once, 10 years ago, but now I'm repeating the cycle.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね20年前も何か寂しさからそちらに走ったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. 20 years ago, was it also loneliness that led you to it?

dialogue.content: 寂しさではないですね
dialogue.English: No, it wasn't loneliness.

dialogue.content: ただ、興味本位でやってから抜け出せなくなりました
dialogue.English: I just tried it out of curiosity and then I couldn't stop.

dialogue.content: 今もお金の欲しさにギャンブルに望みをかけている自分がいます
dialogue.English: Even now, there's a part of me that pins my hopes on gambling because I want money.

dialogue.content: 今も寂しいというよりは、ただお金が欲しいだけなんですよね、
dialogue.English: Even now, it's less about being lonely and more that I just want money.

dialogue.content: お金はとても大事ですものね
dialogue.English: Money is very important, after all.

dialogue.content: お金欲しさということですが、お仕事の方はどうですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned wanting money, so how are things with your job?

dialogue.content: 結局お金がなければ何にもできないです
dialogue.English: In the end, you can't do anything without money.

dialogue.content: ただ、フランチャイズ で飲食店独立とかもやりたいんですが、300万かかるんですよね
dialogue.English: But I'd also like to start my own restaurant through a franchise, and that costs 3 million yen.

dialogue.content: そんな大きな夢をお持ちなのですね
dialogue.English: That's a big dream to have.

dialogue.content: 貯めようと頑張れる時もあるのですが、結局行っちゃうんですよね
dialogue.English: There are times when I can try hard to save, but in the end, I just end up going.

dialogue.content: どうしても止められない。。そんな自分に失望してしまうかんじでしょうか
dialogue.English: You just can't stop... Does that make you feel disappointed in yourself?

dialogue.content: 前向きな友人が夢に向かっているので、それに刺激されました
dialogue.English: My positive friend is working towards their dream, and that inspired me.

dialogue.content: まさにそうですね
dialogue.English: That's exactly it.

dialogue.content: 今のお仕事はどんな状況ですか？
dialogue.English: What is your current job like?

dialogue.content: 車の製造でひたすら肉体労働ですね
dialogue.English: I work in car manufacturing—it's purely physical labor.

dialogue.content: このギャンブル、風俗依存をやめる方法が知りたいです
dialogue.English: I want to know how to quit this gambling and sex service addiction.

dialogue.content: なんかありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything that could help?

dialogue.content: 毎日毎日体を使って大変なご苦労されているのですね
dialogue.English: You're working so hard every day, doing such strenuous physical labor.

dialogue.content: 仕事は慣れたので、今は出来てますが、いずれ気力がなくなるかもという不安もありますね
dialogue.English: I'm used to the job, so I can do it for now, but I worry that at some point I might lose the will to keep going.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、確かにそれは先行きが見通せず辛いですよね。。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be difficult not being able to see a clear path forward.

dialogue.content: 前向きな友人も来月旅立ってしまうので、友人がいなくなれば、前向きな人が居なくなります
dialogue.English: My positive friend is also leaving next month, so when they're gone, there won't be anyone positive around me.

dialogue.content: 辛いです
dialogue.English: It's painful.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mhm.

dialogue.content: ここまでのお話を少し整理させてもらってもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what I've heard so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 借金をしてまで、ギャンブルや風俗から抜け出せず困っておられます
dialogue.English: You're struggling because you can't break free from gambling and sex services, even to the point of going into debt.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 止めたいのに止められない、自分では依存ではないかと思うくらい抜け出せずにいます
dialogue.English: You want to stop but you can't, and you feel so trapped that you think it might be an addiction.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 自殺まで考えてしまうくらい悩んでおられます
dialogue.English: And you're so distressed that you've even considered suicide.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 後30ぷんですよね
dialogue.English: We have 30 minutes left, right?

dialogue.content: 正直、なけなしのお金で相談してるので、何かアドバイスが欲しいです
dialogue.English: Honestly, I'm using the last of my money for this consultation, so I'd really like some advice.

dialogue.content: 何かアドバイスもらえませんか？
dialogue.English: Could you give me some advice?

dialogue.content: はいそうですね出来るだけ早くすすめますね
dialogue.English: Yes, of course. I'll try to move things along as quickly as possible.

dialogue.content: 辞めるための
dialogue.English: On how to quit.

dialogue.content: ここまでのお話で感じたことをお伝えしてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I shared my thoughts on what you've told me so far?

dialogue.content: まだ特に感じてません。。何か解決策が知りたいです
dialogue.English: I don't feel anything in particular yet... I want to know some solutions.

dialogue.content: 解決策ですね、そこが一番大切ですものね一緒に考えていきたいと思います
dialogue.English: A solution, yes. That's the most important thing, isn't it? Let's think about it together.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 習慣をかえるのは難しいです
dialogue.English: Changing habits is difficult.

dialogue.content: 本当にそうですよね。。
dialogue.English: That's absolutely true.

dialogue.content: どうしたら習慣をかえららますかね
dialogue.English: How can I change my habits?

dialogue.content: 習慣を変えたら、いけそうな感じがしますか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel like if you could change your habits, things would get better?

dialogue.content: 何でも習慣からと言うので、そんな気もします
dialogue.English: They say everything starts with habits, so I suppose so.

dialogue.content: 習慣ということでは、、
dialogue.English: Regarding habits...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: ギャンブルには決して手を出さないと自分にまず固く約束をすることですが、出来そうですか？
dialogue.English: The first step would be to make a firm promise to yourself to never gamble again. Does that seem possible?

dialogue.content: それはいいきれないですね、、
dialogue.English: I can't say for sure...

dialogue.content: そうですか、、そうすぐには難しいですよね。。
dialogue.English: I see... it's not easy to do that right away, is it...

dialogue.content: 依存ということがありましたが、
dialogue.English: You mentioned addiction...

dialogue.content: 今までも決意はしても行ってるので、
dialogue.English: I've made resolutions before, but I always end up going.

dialogue.content: 何度も辛い思いをされてきているのですよね。。
dialogue.English: You've been through this painful experience so many times...

dialogue.content: ここまでギャンブルなどの強い刺激を求めておられるのは、
dialogue.English: Given that you seek such strong stimulation from things like gambling,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 確かにご自身一人で何とかするというのは、難しいのではと思いました。
dialogue.English: I think it might be too difficult for you to handle this on your own.

dialogue.content: ですので、
dialogue.English: So...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一度、ギャンブル依存の専門のお医者様を受信されるのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How about seeing a doctor who specializes in gambling addiction?

dialogue.content: 私は決してご自身が弱い人でも、ダメな人でもないと思います
dialogue.English: I truly don't think you are a weak person or a failure at all.

dialogue.content: 病院ですねやはりそれがいちばんですかね
dialogue.English: A hospital... I suppose that's the best way, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はいもし病院にかかって、治療が進めばきっと正常な判断が出来るようになるのではないかと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes. If you go to a hospital and treatment progresses, I believe you will be able to make sound judgments again. What do you think?

dialogue.content: これまで病院はかかられましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever been to a hospital for this before?

dialogue.content: いえ、行っていません。一度行ってみようと思います
dialogue.English: No, I haven't. I think I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: アドバイスありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thank you for the advice!

dialogue.content: 毎日きつい肉体労働できちんと働かれているあなたは、決して弱い人間ではないと思います
dialogue.English: Someone who works so diligently at a hard, physical job every day is by no means a weak person.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Thank you!

dialogue.content: ギャンブルさえ立ち切れれば、借金の問題もおのずと解決に繋がっていくのではないでしょうか
dialogue.English: If you can just break free from gambling, I believe the debt problem will naturally start to resolve itself.

dialogue.content: きっとまじめにこつこつ働けるあなたなら、前進できると信じております！
dialogue.English: I believe that you, being someone who can work diligently and steadily, can move forward!

dialogue.content: まさにその通りですね、出来る事を一つずつやってみます！
dialogue.English: That's exactly right. I'll try to do what I can, one step at a time!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: はい、出来ることから！
dialogue.English: Yes, starting with what you can do!

dialogue.content: 私はあなたのことを心から応援しています！
dialogue.English: I'm cheering for you from the bottom of my heart!

dialogue.content: 絶対に立ち直ってください！
dialogue.English: Please, make a full recovery!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます😭
dialogue.English: Thank you 😭

dialogue.content: それでは本日の相談を終了したいと思いますが、大丈夫でしょうか
dialogue.English: Well then, I would like to conclude today's session, if that's alright with you.

dialogue.content: はい！ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Yes! Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: こちらこそ有難うございました！それでは失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Thank you as well! I'll sign off now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！勉強になりました！！
dialogue.English: Thank you! This has been very helpful!!
